description:
Mark Lawless Auctioneers are delighted to present this superb three-bedroom, semi-detached, two-storey residence, ideally located in the centre of Daingean.
Recently refurbished to a high standard and carefully maintained by its current owners, this attractive home offers bright, spacious accommodation in a convenient village setting.
The ground floor comprises a front sitting room, a kitchen/dining area and a guest WC. Upstairs, there are three bedrooms and a main bathroom. With its central location and well-presented interior, this property will appeal to buyers seeking a comfortable family home or an investment opportunity.
Location
Situated in the heart of Daingean, County Offaly, this property enjoys all the benefits of village life, with local shops, schools and recreational facilities close at hand. Known for its strong community spirit, Daingean offers a welcoming setting surrounded by the scenic Irish countryside.
Road connections provide convenient access to Edenderry, approximately 16 km away, Tullamore, 17 km away, and Mullingar, 30 km away. Combining village charm with easy access to nearby towns, this location offers both convenience and character.


ACCOMMODATION: 

Entrance Hall: 
Tiled flooring, painted wall finish with light fitting. 

Sitting room:
Wooden flooring, fitted units, featured fire place, blinds curtains and curtain pole.

Kitchen/Dining: 
Tiled flooring, modern fitted kitchen units, featured breakfast bar, built in double electric oven, ceramic hob & extractor fan, built-in microwave, wood pellet stove, French doors to rear garden area. 

Guest toilet:
Tiled flooring, painted finish walls, WC & WHB.

Stairs & landing area:
Carpet flooring on stairs & landing area, painted wall finish with light fitting.

Bedroom 1 : 
Wooden flooring, painted wall finish, blinds & light fitting. 

Bathroom: 
Fully tiled, large shower area with WC & vanity unit, towel radiator & extractor unit.

Bedroom 2: 
Wooden flooring, painted wall finish with fitted units, curtains & curtain pole, blinds & light fitting. 

Bedroom 3:
Wooden flooring, painted finish walls, curtains and pole with light fitting.

- Double glazed PVC Windows.
- Wood pellet stove. 
- Modern kitchen units.
- Approx. c.92 sqms 
- Recently refurbished & tastefully decorated. 
- Car parking 
- Excellent location.
